components.name: Store
components.quote: A store node acts as a gateway to block data that is stored in an object storage bucket.

relations.quote: Instead, it is only pointed at an object storage bucket and continuously consolidates multiple smaller blocks into larger ones.
Prometheus instances are configured to continuously write metrics to it
Thanos Querier instead pulls the data from both replicas, and deduplicate those signals, filling the gaps if any, transparently to the Querier consumer.
In short, it gathers the data needed to evaluate the query from underlying [StoreAPIs]
All other API calls just directly go to the downstream Querier
Thanos Receive uploads TSDB blocks to an object storage bucket every 2 hours by default.
Rule nodes in return can discover query nodes to evaluate recording and alerting rules.
Those block files can be backed up to object storage and later be queried by another component (see below).
The `memcached` index cache allows to use [Memcached](https://memcached.org) as cache backend.
It continuously synchronizes which blocks exist in the bucket and translates requests for metric data into object storage requests.
The `redis` index cache allows to use [Redis](https://redis.io) as cache backend.
